en.title: FG42 Assault Rifle Arrives in Black Ops 7 and Warzone Season 5
en.summary: A new weapon is dropping into Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone with the start of Season 5. The FG42 assault rifle is available for free to all players through the Battle Pass.
en.body:
Get ready, soldiers, because **Call of Duty: Black Ops 7** and **Call of Duty: Warzone** are about to receive a significant firepower upgrade. Season 5, launching on July 23, 2026, brings with it a host of new content, including the highly anticipated FG42 assault rifle. This powerful new weapon will be available to all players as part of the free Battle Pass, meaning no Premium or BlackCell purchase is necessary to get your hands on it.

Unlocking the FG42 is a straightforward process that rewards players for engaging with the new season's progression. The weapon is positioned on Page 3 of the Battle Pass, requiring players to earn approximately 15 Battle Pass Tokens to access it. This ensures that players who actively play the game and progress through the tiers will be able to claim this formidable new addition to their arsenal. The FG42 is known for its versatility, and its arrival is expected to shake up the current weapon meta across both **Black Ops 7**'s multiplayer and **Warzone**'s expansive battlegrounds.

## A New Contender Enters the Arena

The FG42 has a storied history within the Call of Duty universe, often recognized for its distinctive full-auto capabilities and potent stopping power. While previous iterations might have been found in more niche locations, like the Mystery Box or specific map weapon lockers in games such as **Call of Duty: WWII**'s Zombies mode, its inclusion as a free Battle Pass reward in **Black Ops 7** and **Warzone** signifies its integration into the core combat experience. This move by **Activision** ensures that a wide range of players, from seasoned veterans to newer recruits, can experience the FG42's potential without financial barriers.

## What This Means for Players

For the passionate **Call of Duty** community, the addition of the FG42 as a free reward is a welcome development. It offers a tangible incentive to dive into Season 5 from day one, encouraging players to grind through the Battle Pass to unlock this new weapon. The FG42's reputation suggests it could become a dominant force, potentially rivaling existing meta weapons. Fans are already speculating on its performance, with many eager to test its recoil, damage output, and overall effectiveness in various combat scenarios, from close-quarters engagements to mid-range duels.

## What's Next

Season 5 of **Call of Duty: Black Ops 7** and **Warzone** officially kicks off on July 23, 2026. Players should prepare to jump in, earn those Battle Pass Tokens, and unlock the FG42 to dominate the battlefield.
